gather_proto_dependencies: run the GatherProto setuptools command to copy gRPC proto files and create __init__.py files
build_python_package: run the BuildPy command to build the Python package including proto dependencies
run_tests_lite: run the TestLite command to execute gRPC tests without fetching or building anything
run_tests_py3_only: run the TestPy3Only command to execute Python 3+ specific gRPC feature tests
run_interop_test: run the RunInterop command to start the gRPC interop test client or server
